subject: Fulfillment reconciliation pilot & contract runway for AWS Marketplace
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lchen@amazon.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Integration <aws-marketplace-integ@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot: reconciliation run + fulfillment testing with Nimbus

Hi Marcus / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. AWS Marketplace team here — we'd like to propose a small-scale reconciliation + fulfillment pilot that will validate:

- SaaS entitlement activation flow (including license mapping from Marketplace entitlement to your internal entitlements)
- Metering event delivery + signature verification for the metering service
- Fulfillment fulfillment (initial account activation flow + invoice mapping)

Proposed scope & timeline (high level):
- Week 0: exchange integration artifacts + test accounts (this week)
- Week 1: deploy test webhook and send replayed events
- Week 2: reconcile test invoices and run a simulated billing cycle

I've attached the metering-webhook-spec (v2) and a one-page checklist for the pilot. Can you share:
1) a technical contact who will receive webhooks and validate signatures
2) a sales/finance contact to review contract/DocuSign path for a limited pilot entitlement

Goal: surface any mapping gaps (SKU <-> entitlement, usage granularity) before we flip the production fulfillment on for Nimbus Analytics.

Lisa Chen
Sr. PM, AWS Marketplace
[Attachment: metering-webhook-spec-v2.pdf (PDF, 340KB)]
[Attachment: pilot-checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
To: Lisa Chen <lchen@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot: reconciliation run + fulfillment testing with Nimbus

Thanks Lisa — this looks good. Quick answers:

- Technical contact: Priyom Das (engineering) — he'll host the webhook endpoint and validate the HMAC signature.
- Sales/finance contact: Vanessa Ortiz — she'll coordinate the limited pilot contract and any DocuSign steps.

Priyom / Soojin, looping you both so we can scope the engineering work and confirm what events we need to ingest. Two immediate asks from our side:

1) Sample metering event payloads (with SKU/usage_type mappings). If you already have an example replay set that would be ideal.
2) Clarify entitlement lifecycle events: when does AWS mark an entitlement as fulfilled vs canceled? We need to align to avoid orphaned seats.

We have a narrow window to run the pilot for Nimbus — they'd like to validate before month-end so we can start billing in the next cycle. Can we aim to have test accounts and webhooks exchanged by EOD Monday (Jan 19)?

Thanks — Marcus
Director, Partnerships (Marketplaces)
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot: reconciliation run + fulfillment testing with Nimbus

Thanks Lisa — Priyom here. A short tech plan from our side:

Scope we plan to cover:
- Ingest metering events (POST /webhooks/metering) with HMAC-SHA256 verification
- Map AWS SKU to Redwood product_id via a small translation table (we'll seed it from your sample payloads)
- Emit internal usage records to our billing pipeline and a reconciliation report endpoint

Questions / notes:
- Please include the sample event set (JSONL preferred). We want at least 48 hours worth of production-like event density to test batching/replay behavior.
- How are you representing fractional usage units in the payload? We need to know if we should expect decimals or integers only.
- For entitlement lifecycle: AWS sends a 'FULFILLMENT' event when entitlement is created and 'REVOCATION' for cancellations. Are there intermediate states (suspended / pending) we should expect?

Attachments: I'm adding our internal SaaS-Fulfillment-Checklist.xlsx (pilot-runway tab) which lists the endpoints we will expose and the reconciliation report format.

ETA: We can get a test webhook up in our dev cluster by Monday (Jan 19) if we receive the sample events by COB Friday (Jan 16).

- Priyom
Senior Backend Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SaaS-Fulfillment-Checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 92KB)]

Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot: reconciliation run + fulfillment testing with Nimbus

Great — thanks Priyom, Marcus.

Attached a sample event bundle (JSONL) and the signed test account details for Nimbus. A couple of clarifications:

- Fractional usage: sent as decimal strings (e.g., "1.25") in the payloads.
- Intermediate states: Marketplace currently supports PENDING, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, and REVOKED; only ACTIVE triggers a FULFILLMENT event.

DocuSign: I've started the limited pilot DocuSign envelope for the SaaS addendum and shared the link with Vanessa. If Vanessa confirms, we can set the effective date to Jan 20 for the pilot.

[Attachment: marketplace-sample-events.jsonl (JSONL, 240KB)]

Lisa
Sr. PM, AWS Marketplace

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
To: Lisa Chen <lchen@amazon.com>, AWS Marketplace Integration <aws-marketplace-integ@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example>, Andy Park (Nimbus Analytics) <procurement@nimbus.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot: reconciliation run + fulfillment testing with Nimbus

Appreciate the artifacts and the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and owners: 

- Vanessa (finance/sales): please confirm DocuSign envelope and effective date (Lisa suggested Jan 20).
- Priyom (eng): will stand up the dev webhook and validate HMAC + decimal parsing by EOD Mon (Jan 26).
- Soojin (marketplace ops): will own the reconciliation report format and run the first diff with AWS-provided sample events.

Meeting: proposing a 30-minute kickoff on Monday, Jan 26 at 10:00 AM PT to validate the test replay and review the first reconciliation snapshot. Calendar invite to follow.

A couple of operational asks for the pilot (short):
- We need the HubSpot deal link updated with the pilot scope and estimated revenue ($9k/month) so finance can map billing codes.
- Please confirm whether AWS will issue metering events with the buyer identity (customer_email) so our activation can auto-associate accounts. If not, we'll require a manual mapping table.

If everyone is aligned I'll mark the pilot as ON and share the kickoff invite.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Partnerships (Marketplaces)
Redwood Inference
